title: Tio's Buffet clarinet and his own B flat clarinet
summary: Tio used a 13-key Buffet; Cottrell's father bought the B flat clarinet he still plays.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: They would either shave or cut them down the way they felt was best. Do you remember anything about his instrument? How many keys he had on it? He had a 13. 13? The 13 clarinet. I can remember that. Remember the make by any chance? Buffet.

Yeah, it was a Buffet. I can remember it being a Buffet. The C clarinet that you had, do you remember the make of that? No, I really don't remember the make of that. Was that the regular 15 key? No, I think it was the 13 key. 13 key. Yeah, the 13 key. Mm-hmm. Yeah, it was 13 key. The loan did Lorenzo do? Yeah, it was his. It was his. Now, when you, you say you were on that about six months, when you went to the B flat, was that also unloaned from him? No.
He told my dad there was no need to push him because he knew that it wasn't going to be too long, you see. He said, my daddy bought me one. Uh-huh. It wasn't make of that.
It's the one that I have now.
Is that the same one? It's the same clarinet.
Wait a minute, that's a pencil mark? That's a mark. Yeah, I remember saying it with that. Yeah, it's the same clarinet. Mm-hmm. Wow, that's really held up a long time. It really did.
